items.quote: Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do
items.claim: God will not conceal His actions from Abraham

items.quote: Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation
items.claim: Abraham will become a great and mighty nation

items.quote: all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him
items.claim: All nations of the earth will be blessed through Abraham

items.quote: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him
items.claim: Abraham will command his children and household

items.quote: they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment
items.claim: Abraham's descendants will keep the way of the Lord through practicing justice and judgment

items.quote: that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him
items.claim: God will bring upon Abraham what He has spoken concerning him
